# Control mapping

**Framework:** ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A (2022)  
**Source:** https://www.iso.org/standard/27001  
**Controls:** 36 (10 automated, 26 manual)  
**Generated by:** `python scripts/generate_mapping.py`

The YAML catalog at `cee/frameworks/iso27001_2022.yaml` is the source of truth.
A control is automated when at least one check is mapped to it. Everything else
requires manual evidence through `python -m cee attest`.

## Organizational (A.5)

| Control | Title | Type | Checks | Evidence expectation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A.5.1 | Policies for information security | Manual | - | Approved information security policy with version, owner, approval date and a review date within the last 12 months; evidence of communication to staff. |
| A.5.2 | Information security roles and responsibilities | Manual | - | RACI or role definitions covering security ownership, approvals and operational duties, signed off by management. |
| A.5.3 | Segregation of duties | Manual | - | Access matrix showing production, approval and review duties are separated; exception register for unavoidable conflicts. |
| A.5.7 | Threat intelligence | Manual | - | Threat-intelligence sources, collection cadence, dissemination records and examples of intelligence driving detection or remediation decisions. |
| A.5.9 | Inventory of information and other associated assets | Manual | - | Asset register export with owner, classification, location and criticality; reconciliation evidence against cloud and endpoint inventories. |
| A.5.10 | Acceptable use of information and other associated assets | Manual | - | Acceptable use policy with acknowledged acceptance records for employees and contractors. |
| A.5.12 | Classification of information | Manual | - | Classification scheme, criteria and examples; sample assets showing assigned classification labels. |
| A.5.15 | Access control | Manual | - | Access control policy, role model, provisioning workflow and periodic access review records. |
| A.5.17 | Authentication information | Automated | `github_mfa`, `windows_password_policy` | Password and MFA baseline configuration, identity-provider policy export and evidence that organization accounts enforce the baseline. |
| A.5.19 | Information security in supplier relationships | Manual | - | Supplier register with risk tier, security requirements, due-diligence evidence and contract clauses. |
| A.5.23 | Information security for use of cloud services | Manual | - | Cloud service inventory, shared-responsibility mapping, configuration baseline and exit plan for critical services. |
| A.5.24 | Information security incident management planning and preparation | Manual | - | Incident response plan, contact matrix, severity matrix, tooling readiness and evidence of exercised readiness. |
| A.5.25 | Assessment and decision on information security events | Manual | - | Triage criteria and sampled event records showing classification decisions and rationale. |
| A.5.26 | Response to information security incidents | Manual | - | Incident records with timeline, containment, eradication, recovery, root cause and lessons learned. |
| A.5.29 | Information security during disruption | Manual | - | Business continuity and disaster recovery plans with security controls, RTO/RPO targets and test results. |
| A.5.34 | Privacy and protection of PII | Manual | - | Data map or record of processing, lawful basis, retention schedule, privacy notices and DSAR handling records. |

## People (A.6)

| Control | Title | Type | Checks | Evidence expectation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A.6.3 | Information security awareness, education and training | Manual | - | Training curriculum, completion records, phishing-simulation results and onboarding/refresh cadence. |
| A.6.5 | Responsibilities after termination or change of employment | Manual | - | Offboarding checklist, access revocation evidence and return-of-assets records for a sample of leavers. |

## Physical (A.7)

| Control | Title | Type | Checks | Evidence expectation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A.7.1 | Physical security perimeters | Manual | - | Floor plans, perimeter controls, access-controlled zones and site inspection records. |
| A.7.2 | Physical entry | Manual | - | Badge access lists, visitor logs, approval records and periodic access reviews for secure areas. |
| A.7.4 | Physical security monitoring | Manual | - | CCTV or alarm configuration, retention period and sample monitoring records. |
| A.7.10 | Storage media | Manual | - | Media register, encryption and handling procedures, and secure destruction certificates. |

## Technological (A.8)

| Control | Title | Type | Checks | Evidence expectation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A.8.2 | Privileged access rights | Automated | `aws_root_mfa` | Privileged account inventory, approval records, MFA enforcement and evidence that root or break-glass accounts are controlled. |
| A.8.5 | Secure authentication | Automated | `github_mfa`, `windows_password_policy` | MFA enforcement for workforce identities, password baseline and authentication logs for critical systems. |
| A.8.7 | Protection against malware | Manual | - | EDR or antivirus coverage report, policy configuration, signature update status and malware incident records. |
| A.8.8 | Management of technical vulnerabilities | Automated | `trivy_vulnerability_sla` | Vulnerability scan reports, prioritization method, remediation SLAs and evidence of timely patching for critical and high findings. |
| A.8.9 | Configuration management | Manual | - | Hardening baselines, configuration drift reports and approved exception records. |
| A.8.12 | Data leakage prevention | Automated | `aws_s3_public_block` | Storage and network exposure controls, DLP policy configuration and evidence of monitoring for sensitive data leaving controlled environments. |
| A.8.13 | Information backup | Automated | `backup_freshness` | Backup inventory, freshness against RPO, retention coverage and restore-test records. |
| A.8.15 | Logging | Automated | `aws_cloudtrail`, `windows_audit_policy` | Centralized logging configuration, audit policy for identity events, retention settings and protection against tampering. |
| A.8.16 | Monitoring activities | Automated | `wazuh_alert_pipeline`, `sigma_detection_coverage`, `aws_guardduty` | SIEM ingestion health, detection coverage against priority techniques, cloud threat detection and alert triage records. |
| A.8.20 | Networks security | Manual | - | Network segmentation diagram, firewall rule review, secure configuration baseline and remote-access controls. |
| A.8.24 | Use of cryptography | Manual | - | Cryptographic standard, approved algorithms, key-management procedures and inventory of where encryption is applied. |
| A.8.28 | Secure coding | Automated | `github_secret_scanning` | Secure coding standard, SAST and dependency-scanning results, secret scanning and evidence that findings are remediated. |
| A.8.32 | Change management | Automated | `github_branch_protection` | Change approval records, protected default branches, required peer review and deployment audit trail. |
| A.8.34 | Protection of information systems during audit testing | Manual | - | Audit engagement plan, testing window approvals, read-only access evidence and post-testing review records. |
